> >
>
> But technically, when would you considered the blocking vamp tapped, if
> the blocking is not sucessful? At the end of Vamp B's action?

He taps when the action resolves (either with a successful block or
by not being blocked).

> And what will happen if i decide to change Vamp A for Vamp C (AUS) for
> the blocking? Will I have to tap Vamp A?

Yes, since A was attempting to block when FN was played.
